turns.question: Which kind of customer call left people happiest in September 2026, and in what share of those calls?
turns.answer: Product calls left customers happiest in September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30): the positive-sentiment share (model-derived) was 0.75, i.e. 75 % of labelled product calls (12 positive calls of 16 calls labelled); delivery, pricing and returns calls had no positive calls, so their share came back empty.
